verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product page directly claims AI-powered intake that parses contracts and screenshots to auto-populate request forms, which matches this story exactly. Approval routing across finance, IT, legal and security supports the procurement-request context. The evidence is a single marketing line with no detailed docs. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of contract-parsing intake (supported fields, document types, accuracy, review flow), independent or hands-on corroboration.
